title: On Fano indices of weighted projective spaces
summary: The Sylvester sequence is defined recursively by $s_1=2$ and $s_i=s_{1}\cdots s_{i-1}+1$. In this paper, we prove that the Fano index of an $n$-dimensional well-formed weighted projective space with canonical singularities is bounded above by \[ (s_n-1)(2s_n-3). \] This gives an affirmative answer to a conjecture of Chengxi Wang for weighted projective spaces and $\mathbb Q$-factorial toric Fano varieties with Picard number one.
